you_should_know.title: San Antonio City Council rejects November vote on Spurs arena funding; members react
you_should_know.summary: The fight over whether San Antonio voters would get a say on the city's $489 million contribution to a new Spurs arena came to a head. City Manager Erik Walsh warned city leaders about 'misinformation' circulating ahead of the council's debate; the meeting then ran nearly two and a half hours of public input, with most speakers pressing unsuccessfully for a referendum; and the council narrowly voted against putting the funding to a November residential vote, a decision that drew immediate reaction from its members.
you_should_know.description: San Antonio's City Council narrowly voted against allowing residents to vote on the city's $489 million contribution to a new Spurs arena, sparking a debate.
